# Viktig marknad för Volvo backar – Börsen mot öppning i sidled

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-05  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon with Handelsbanken strategist Mattias Sundling. He is broadly bullish on equities into year-end, driven by strong earnings and US productivity, but expects choppy trading over the next few weeks ahead of the US midterms, which he sees as buying opportunities. On sectors, he recommends staying neutral rather than overweight on engineering stocks such as Volvo and SKF as industrial PMI nears a peak, prefers consumer-related stocks, and highlights Nordnet and Avanza as structural growth names. The hosts also covered a wave of M&A (Schneider/PTC, AkzoNobel's Asia sale, Lantmännen buying into Scandi Standard) and weak North American truck orders weighing on Volvo.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SAVE — Nordnet | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Guest (Handelsbanken strategist) names Nordnet a top financials pick: non-cyclical growth, ~12% customer growth, reasonable valuation

#### Reasoning

Sundling calls the online brokers his favourite financials. Customer inflows are growing about 12%, there is a structural growth story as Germany and others adopt Swedish-style saving, and the valuation is not stretched. He admits the stocks are high-beta and need a strong market to keep inflows coming.

#### Sell Triggers

- if customer inflow growth slows materially
- if equity market sentiment turns sharply negative

> *"Det här är våra topics i finans... sektorn. 12 % för Nordnet, 8 % för Avanza. Det här är tillväxtstories som inte är speciellt cykliska."*

---

### 🟢 AZA — Avanza | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest names Avanza a top financials pick alongside Nordnet; ~8% customer growth, non-cyclical growth story

#### Reasoning

Same view as Nordnet: steady customer inflows (~8%), structural support from savings trends, and a valuation that is not excessive given the growth. The stocks depend on a strong market (beta).

#### Sell Triggers

- if net customer inflows decline
- if the equity market weakens significantly

> *"Inte nån häpnadsväckande värdering med tanke på hur bra de växer."*

---

### 🟡 VOLV-B — Volvo | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest: keep Volvo but not overweight vs index as industrial PMI nears a peak; weak NA truck orders seen as EPA27 timing effect

#### Reasoning

Sundling sees industrial PMI near a peak, a stage when engineering stocks usually lag the market. He would not sell them but would not overweight them either. He reads the -9.5% North American truck orders as a timing effect from EPA27 rule uncertainty rather than weakening demand.

#### Sell Triggers

- if truck order weakness persists beyond the EPA27 timing effect
- if industrial earnings growth stalls

> *"Jag menar inte att man ska sälja alla sina Volvo och SKF. Det är klart man ska ha dem. Men man kanske inte ska ha dem i en övervikt kontra index."*

---

### 🟡 SKF-B — SKF | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Guest: keep engineering stocks like SKF but not overweight near the PMI peak

#### Reasoning

Sector-level view: cyclical engineering stocks rarely beat the index when leading industrial indicators are near their peak, so hold at neutral weight.

#### Sell Triggers

- if industrial PMI rolls over sharply

> *"Jag menar inte att man ska sälja alla sina Volvo och SKF."*

---

### 🟡 SINCH — Sinch | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cited analyst (Handelsbanken) cut to hold but raised its 12-month target; moving the right way but with challenges

#### Reasoning

Handelsbanken sees Sinch improving but still facing challenges. It downgraded to hold after the share-price run while raising its 12-month target price. This is a cited analyst view, not the hosts' own.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the operational improvement stalls

> *"Man sänker faktiskt rekommendationen till behåll från tidigare men man höjer riktkursen på 12 månaders sikt."*

---

### 🟠 SCST — Scandi Standard | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Lantmännen and Lusiaves both buying; host likes stocks with a structural buyer

#### Reasoning

Two strategic holders are competing for stakes: Lantmännen to block a takeover and Portuguese Lusiaves on the buy side. The host likes the structural buying flow, but Lantmännen's blocking stance may limit takeover upside.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the strategic buyers stop accumulating

> *"Jag gillar aktier där det finns en strukturell köpare och ett flöde."*

---

### 🟠 BETS-B — Betsson | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host: Brazil's first-round election result could favour the betting sector; stock up ~2%

#### Reasoning

Speculative short-term read: Bolsonaro Jr. leads Lula, who recently announced gambling regulation, so the betting sector could benefit.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Brazil runoff outcome reverses
- if adverse gambling regulation in Brazil

> *"Den sektorn, bettingen, skulle kunna må bra idag eftersom det verkar bli fördel."*

---

### 🟠 VIT-B — Vitec | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host: the Schneider/PTC software M&A theme could benefit Vitec; software sold off on AI fears

#### Reasoning

The host speculates that big software takeovers validate cheap software valuations hit by AI panic, with read-across to Swedish software names.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the software M&A wave fades

> *"det här skulle kunna gynna ett vitek eller ett adnode."*

---

### 🟠 ANOD-B — Addnode | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host: PTC deal read-across could benefit Addnode (product lifecycle software)

#### Reasoning

PTC is a product lifecycle (PLM) software company, as Addnode partly is. The takeover suggests strategic value in that kind of software, which is a speculative positive.

#### Sell Triggers

- if no further software M&A materialises

> *"det här skulle kunna gynna ett vitek eller ett adnode."*

---

### 🟠 VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Cited analyst (Deutsche Bank) sees no need for further financing, which could support the shares

#### Reasoning

Deutsche Bank's view removes the overhang of a possible capital raise. This is a cited analyst view mentioned briefly by the host.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Volvo Cars announces new financing

> *"Deutsche tror sig inte se behov av ytterligare finansiering skulle kunna gynna den aktien."*
